an11.12:2.2: “several mendicants are making a robe for the Buddha, thinking that
an11.12:2.3: ‘when his robe was finished and the three months of the rains residence had passed the Buddha would set out wandering’”
an11.12:5.6: ‘There are the gods of the four great kings … there are gods even higher than these.
an11.12:5.7: Endowed with faith of that sort, those deities passed away from here and were reborn there; I, too, have faith of that sort.
an11.12:5.11: Endowed with wisdom of that sort, those deities passed away from here and were reborn there; I, too, have wisdom of that sort.’
